config.farmstead_footprints.title: Footprints settings
config.farmstead_footprints.preset.toolt: Sets every value below at once. Values you change afterwards are kept.
config.farmstead_footprints.general.enab: Master switch. Off: no prints are made or drawn.
config.farmstead_footprints.general.chec: Once at start-up, ask Modrinth whether a newer Footprints is out and say so in the log. Sends nothing about you.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.m: How many prints can exist at once. The oldest disappear first when the limit is reached.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.r: Blocks from the camera within which prints are made and drawn.
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.l: Multiplies how long prints stay before they fade (snow 5 min, sand 3 min at 1.0).
config.farmstead_footprints.footprints.e: Entity ids that never leave prints, separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:villager.
farmstead_footprints.command.problems: Footprints settings: %s problem(s), see below. Fix the file and run /footprints reload again.
farmstead_footprints.command.stats: Footprints: %s prints of %s, drawn last frame: %s.
